\centering\small
\caption{CausalRivers head-to-head, per configuration.  Mean per-sample AUROC/AUPRC with the diagonal removed (the benchmark's own convention), oracle-threshold max-F1, mean SHD at each method's own decision threshold, and CPU wall-clock over the whole sample set.  \textbf{AUPRC is the metric to read}: these graphs are sparse, so AUROC is dominated by the negative class.  The two arms must not be collapsed: the \emph{scale-exploiting} arm is the published protocol, in which the raw discharge magnitude encodes edge direction and largely produces the published VAR $0.85$; the \emph{scale-free} arm removes that prior and is the actual causal-discovery comparison.  Every method gets the same lag budget, preprocessing and timeout; failures and timeouts are reported, not dropped.}
\label{tab:bench_rivers}
